'''2004 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 17 July 2004 at Outer Limits Comics, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee, and organized by [[Royce Russell]]. The winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]] and the opportunity to design a virtual card. [[Brandon Ruck]] won from a field of 14 players.<ref name="pcf-3428">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428&amp 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (7 June – 10 August 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 September 2004.</ref> Russell reminded players to get Decipher's new player numbers before the event, since the event received extra foils from Decipher for players who had them.<ref name="pcf-3428-48283">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48283#48283 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Players as far away as Indiana and Florida asked about the event, and on the Friday night before it Russell ran a MegaMan TCG constructed tournament at the store for early arrivals.<ref name="pcf-3428-49553">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=49553#49553 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Many of the regular monthly local players chose to sit the championship out.<ref name="pcf-3428-51476">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51476#51476 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Outer Limits Comics, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="pcf-3428" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 July 2004<ref name="pcf-3428" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Royce Russell]]<ref name="pcf-3428" />
* '''Players:''' 14<ref name="pcf-3428" />
* '''Start:''' 11:00 AM, registration from 10:15 AM<ref name="pcf-3428-47290">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47290#47290 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Entry fee:''' $10, to be lowered if a sponsor was found<ref name="pcf-3428-47290" />
* '''Prizes:''' the Players Committee's "Biggie Size" prize package; prizes for all participants, including uncut sheets, tournament foils and booster packs<ref name="pcf-3428-47422">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47422#47422 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (Roycer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Ruck]]<ref name="pcf-3428" />
